name: Eternal Salvation
overview: Scripture reveals that eternal salvation is a gift from God granted to those who believe in Jesus Christ, assuring them everlasting life and freedom from condemnation. Jesus promises that all who come to Him will never be cast out and that those given to Him by the Father will never perish nor be taken from His hand. This salvation is unchangeable and secure, reflecting God's eternal purpose and the believer's passage from death to life.
